name: rules-rtdb-r40-auth-token-dynamic-index
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r40-auth-token-dynamic-index" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). indexing auth.token with a missing child value (null) or a number must match production rather than coercing null to the claim key "null" via String(idx).
